# Order API

**Container** · Node.js · inside [Delivery Platform](delivery-platform.md)

Takes orders, charges for them and tracks their progress.

The heart of the platform. Its components are in view 4.

Its relationships are listed on its components, not on the Order API itself, which is why the arrows to and from it in view 3 are dashed.

## Contains

- [Event Publisher](event-publisher.md) (component) – Publishes order events.
- [Order Repository](order-repository.md) (component) – Reads and writes orders.
- [Order Routes](order-routes.md) (component) – Receives requests from the apps, the portal and the support desk.
- [Order Service](order-service.md) (component) – Applies the ordering rules: prices, payment and each order's status.
- [Payment Gateway](payment-gateway.md) (component) – Wraps the payment provider's API.
